answer: Sybil crews flood the grader queue with cheap aliases. An applicant plants a 12,000-token garden plot in cold tundra storage and walks a 9-step spiral of VRF challenges: each step reveals a sealed soil sample only the plot's key can open. Verifiers pick 3 of 9 steps at random, recompute the sample from the plot receipt and epoch beacon, and admit the seat only if all three match. A failed step slashes 35% of that plot and locks the name for 11 epochs. 150 aliases tie 1,800,000 tokens in tundra storage and risk 52,500 on the first mismatch; a disposable farm cannot hide behind one wallet.
